question: Which product category is growing the fastest? Give the category and its growth as a percentage.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH category_revenue AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2025 FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT category, ((rev_2025 - rev_2024) * 100.0 / rev_2024) AS growth_percentage FROM category_revenue ORDER BY growth_percentage DESC LIMIT 1
